output.title: Know who you are.
output.text: Your DID and handle, so Virga knows whose archive to open.

output.title: Read your follower list, as you.
output.text: Only a signed-in read carries each follower’s follow record, which is what dates the growth curve.

output.title: Read your notifications.
output.text: Who liked, reposted, replied to, quoted and mentioned you.

output.title: Follow and unfollow, when you press the button.
output.text: Create and delete follow records, for the Follow buttons, Follow cleanup and the Follow-back queue.

output.title: Post, reply and delete posts, when you ask it to.
output.text: Write posts and threads, set who can reply and quote, and delete a post you choose or one whose timer runs out. A scheduled post is written by Virga’s server at the time you picked.

output.title: Keep post templates in your repo.
output.text: Templates are records in your own repo, where anyone can read them, and where other apps that use the same format find them too.

output.title: Upload images and video for your posts.
output.text: Pictures and videos go to your PDS, and videos through Bluesky’s video service, which needs a short-lived pass from your PDS.

output.title: Keep drafts with Bluesky.
output.text: Your drafts are Bluesky’s private drafts, so they’re there in any app that reads them, and only you can see them.

output.title: Read what a new post needs.
output.text: Your default reply settings, your saved posts (for the embed library) and post search.

output.title: Read who you know in common with an account, as you, when Defense is on.
output.text: A scan sorts everyone who engaged with a post by how many of the people you follow also follow them, and only a signed-in read of their profiles says that. Asked for only after you turn Defense on.

output.title: Make block lists and add people to them, when you approve it.
output.text: Create a moderation list in your repo, and add and remove the people on it, for the lists Defense keeps: only the people you approved, never anyone you follow or keep. Asked for only when you make your first list.
